candidates.name: Squarespace

candidates.rationale: Squarespace provides an online storefront and e-commerce platform that merchants could evaluate alongside Shopify to build and operate online stores.

candidates.name: VTEX Partnership

candidates.name: Ecwid, Inc.

candidates.name: Volusion, LLC

candidates.name: Fynd

candidates.name: OpenCart Limited

candidates.name: Priority Technology Holdings, Inc.

candidates.name: Lazada

candidates.name: Daraz Group

candidates.name: Tatwa Technologies Ltd.
candidates.description: Both provide business technology services that include mobility and m-commerce solutions for retail businesses.

candidates.name: Weebly, Inc.
